Review of 'Super Subbu' series on Netflix

The Netflix series 'Super Subbu', a Telugu original, has been reviewed by Indian media. Directed by Mallik Ram, the series features actor Sundeep Kishan. Critics note that the show uses humor and social commentary to address the topic of sex education, particularly in a rural setting.
